$comment: Phase A: box-shaped atoms. Axis values come from the story's argTypes. rootSelector is REQUIRED — the story root is a css-in-js Box wrapper, not the component; take the class from the component's .styles.scss. axisValues overrides an axis (null = omit the arg, which is how Fuselage spells an unnamed default). oneOf collapses mutually exclusive boolean args into a single axis. fluidWidth marks block-level components whose measured width is only the story canvas.

skipped.name: ProgressBar
skipped.reason: variant colour is on the child bar, not the root track — needs child-node measurement (Phase B)

skipped.name: CheckBox
skipped.reason: checked/indeterminate render on a child <i>; the root is a transparent 20x20 box

skipped.name: RadioButton
skipped.reason: same as CheckBox — state lives on a child, root never changes

skipped.name: ToggleSwitch
skipped.reason: same as CheckBox — state lives on a child, root never changes

skipped.name: StatusBullet
skipped.reason: it is an SVG; status colour is the path fill, not a CSS background (Phase B: vectors)

skipped.name: ToastBar
skipped.reason: variant produces no measurable change on the root element

skipped.name: Avatar
skipped.reason: the size arg is not applied by the story — the class stays rcx-avatar--x16 regardless

skipped.name: Card
skipped.reason: horizontal/clickable produce no measurable change on the root element

skipped.name: CodeSnippet
skipped.reason: buttonDisabled affects a child button, not the root

skipped.name: Tile
skipped.reason: elevation maps to box-shadow, which the extractor does not capture yet — 5 variants measured as 2. Shadow extraction is the clear next increment: Fuselage already has shadow-elevation-* tokens published in Figma.

skipped.name: Bubble
skipped.reason: .rcx-bubble is a layout wrapper: transparent fill, full container width, and unstyled text (measured rgb(0,0,0) — pure black is not in the Fuselage palette). The styled content is in children.

skipped.name: Skeleton
skipped.reason: the shimmer is an animated linear-gradient background-image, not a background-color, so background-color reads transparent and the variant ships blank. Needs gradient paint support (Figma GRADIENT_LINEAR) plus a decision on how to represent the animation.

skipped.name: Throbber
skipped.reason: the dots are child elements with their own background-color and a bounce animation; .rcx-throbber itself is a transparent flex wrapper, so all variants measure identically. Needs child-node measurement (Phase B).

skipped.name: Chevron
skipped.reason: direction is expressed as transform: rotate(), which the extractor does not measure — only 2 of 5 variants render distinctly. Figma would need the rotation applied to the node, not a fill change.

outOfScope.name: Accordion
outOfScope.reason: composite — a list of expandable items; each row is its own component

outOfScope.name: AutoComplete
outOfScope.reason: composite — wraps an input plus a floating Options list

outOfScope.name: ButtonGroup
outOfScope.reason: layout container — its appearance is entirely the Buttons inside it

outOfScope.name: CardGroup
outOfScope.reason: layout container — appearance comes from the Cards inside it

outOfScope.name: Dropdown
outOfScope.reason: composite — a floating surface positioned around a trigger

outOfScope.name: Field
outOfScope.reason: composite — label, input, hint and error rows

outOfScope.name: FieldGroup
outOfScope.reason: layout container for Fields

outOfScope.name: Grid
outOfScope.reason: layout primitive — no visual surface of its own

outOfScope.name: Modal
outOfScope.reason: composite — backdrop, surface, header, content and footer

outOfScope.name: NavBar
outOfScope.reason: composite — a bar of other components

outOfScope.name: Option
outOfScope.reason: row inside Options; measured meaningfully only in that context

outOfScope.name: Options
outOfScope.reason: composite — a scrollable list of Option rows

outOfScope.name: Pagination
outOfScope.reason: composite — buttons plus a page-size Select

outOfScope.name: Select
outOfScope.reason: composite — a trigger plus a floating Options list

outOfScope.name: Sidebar
outOfScope.reason: composite — the largest one; rows, headers, search, banners

outOfScope.name: Sidepanel
outOfScope.reason: composite — a panel shell containing other components

outOfScope.name: States
outOfScope.reason: composite — icon, title, subtitle and actions

outOfScope.name: Table
outOfScope.reason: composite — head, body, rows and cells

outOfScope.name: Tabs
outOfScope.reason: composite — a strip of Tab items

outOfScope.name: Icon
outOfScope.reason: a single glyph with no visual axes; belongs to the icon-sprite work (Phase B), and validateSpec requires at least one axis
